fields.label: Aspects
fields.value: A Paper Beast That Smells Broken Promises; Cannot Hunt a Debt Honestly Forgiven; Bound to the Office Seal.

fields.label: Appearance / behavior
fields.value: A folded-black-paper hound, its ribs covered in crossed-out signatures. It circles a debtor before choosing which promise to track.

fields.label: Want
fields.value: Consume the written record of an unfulfilled obligation. Its keeper uses that appetite to patrol the collection engine.

fields.label: Mechanics
fields.value: Fight +3, Notice +2, Athletics +1, Physique +1; unlisted +0. Physical [1][2][3], mental [1][2], one box per hit. Empty mild consequence 2.

fields.label: Stunt proposal
fields.value: Scent the Default: +2 Notice to create an advantage tracking a specific broken promise while holding its signed record. Not general lie detection.

fields.label: Counterplay
fields.value: An honestly forgiven debt loses its scent. A different signed broken promise can draw the hound away; a convincing false scent requires an appropriate create-advantage action. It is not obliged to attack someone who offers food.

fields.label: GM truth
fields.value: It guards records, not Vale personally. Its binding can be transferred by a lawful Office seal; destroying it is only one possible solution.
